title: Urban Furdo — full E2E booking (choose groom → availability → time → checkout, STOPS before Book)
_note: Captured live 2026-05-30 via agent-browser. The full path: pick service → Add → Next → next-available → time slot → CHECKOUT page (with the 'Book appointment' button visible). The final 'Book appointment' click + the personal-details form are DELIBERATELY OMITTED — this reaches the confirmation/checkout page but never creates a real appointment. Square dynamic classes are unstable, so button steps use Recorder text/ selectors (stable across re-renders) — a key finding for the memory-skill capture contract.
